questions.question: Approve the early appointment dates: the source gives professorship and Royal Society fellowship in 1841, but the Society’s election certificate is dated 25 April 1839 and already calls him a UCL professor, https://catalogues.royalsociety.org/CalmView/Record.aspx?id=EC%2F1839%2F24&src=CalmView.Catalog . The source gives Virginia tenure as 1841–1843, whereas the university library dates his departure to March 1842, https://explore.lib.virginia.edu/exhibits/show/seek/jefferson .

questions.question: Clarify arrival at Johns Hopkins: the source gives 1877, the university library May 1876, https://www.library.jhu.edu/news/2014/01/james-joseph-sylvester/ . Distinguish the journal’s organization from its first 1878 volume. For Oxford distinguish formal tenure from the end of active teaching: the university summary and OUP chapter give different end dates, 1897 and 1894, https://www.maths.ox.ac.uk/system/files/media/Savilian%20Professors.pdf and https://academic.oup.com/book/38840/chapter-abstract/337749115 .
